title: Free Men Remember
summary: A letter from one of the men you freed from the Cursed Quarries. He's home in Ashford, and he'd like to see you.

goals.say: He shakes your hand too long, the way men do when they've been in chains. 'If anyone ever says a word against you,' he says, 'they'll have to say it over me.'
goals.name: Freed Ashford Man

quest_book.title: From the Quarries
quest_book.author: Corin Vale, of Ashford
pages: You won't remember me. I was the one with the broken hand, fourth in the line, the morning you came down into the quarries and killed the things that drove us.
Three years I dug gold for a god I'd never seen. I'd stopped being able to picture my wife's face. Now I see it every morning.

I'm home. Ashford's half-built and the roof leaks and I've never been happier. Come and see. I owe you a drink and a great deal more than a drink.

- Corin Vale

threats.name: Freed Ashford Man
threats.target_line: You came! You actually came. Sit. Sit down. I'll find the good cups.
